title: APIs That Make Apps Feel Premium

sections.heading: Everyday Analogy
sections.body:
Think of building an app like opening a coffee shop. You could build your own tables, ovens, and security system. Or you can buy ready-made parts from specialists.

An API (Application Programming Interface) is a ready-made service your app can call to do one job well, so you don't build it from scratch.

sections.heading: Why it exists
sections.body:
These 5 APIs add polish that users feel instantly:

- Mapbox gives custom maps, smooth UI, and real-time location.
- Resend sends transactional email, meaning automatic emails like receipts or logins, with better developer experience (DX) than old tools.
- Clerk handles auth (authentication), meaning logins and user management, with a polished UI.
- Stream adds real-time chat, feeds, and video.
- Cloudinary optimizes and delivers images and video via a CDN (Content Delivery Network), a network of servers that serves files fast nearby.

sections.heading: What can go wrong
sections.body:
If you rely on an outside API, you also rely on its limits.

If usage grows 100x, the first things to break are cost, rate limits, and speed. Map or image calls can get expensive, email can hit spam folders or quotas, auth can lock users out, and chat/video can lag.

Always check pricing, limits, and what happens when the API is down.

steps.narration: Your app is the coffee shop that needs specialist help.
Clerk checks IDs at the door with auth.
Mapbox draws the custom map to find you.
Resend delivers the receipt email after.
Stream lets users chat in real time inside.
Cloudinary shrinks and delivers images fast via CDN.

quiz.q: What does an API let your app do?
options: Call a specialist service for one job
Replace the need for any servers
quiz.why: APIs are ready-made services you call instead of building that job yourself.

quiz.q: What fails first if usage grows 100x?
options: Cost, rate limits, and speed break
quiz.why: More calls mean higher bills, hit quotas, and lag if the API can't scale.

quiz.q: Which API matches the premium polish job?
options: Cloudinary for image/video optimization via CDN
quiz.why: Cloudinary optimizes and delivers media via CDN; Mapbox is maps, Resend is email, Clerk is auth, Stream is chat/feeds/video.
